author: sovyre
name: Sovyre
text:
She shot porn for six or seven years. Then she walked into a three-hour seminar that turned out to be about Islam, bought a Quran and changed her name.

Ask Rae Lil Black if she regrets the porn and she says no. "If I didn't do this, maybe I didn't meet Islam."

In the video below, the host asks how she survived being sexualized every day. Wait for what she says the Quran told her about everyone who judges her.

Everybody assumes it's a gimmick. She says the conversion cost her hundreds of thousands of followers.

Born Kae Asakura in Japan, she moved to Europe, then to Thailand. The money from porn? "It's a secret." When she started, she says, "I was stupid. It was cheap, but I agreed."

Before Islam she admits she was "a very bad daughter." She moved to Europe without telling her parents and blocked them for a whole year. Now she calls them three or four times a week.

Some Muslims still call her a liar. She doesn't care. "I don't need humans' acceptance."

Her new name is Nuray Istiqbal.

Real conversion, or the smartest rebrand in porn history?
